body:
OWNER: TWO INDEPENDENT MEASUREMENTS OF THE SAME ARTIFACT AGREE, WHICH IS WORTH MORE THAN EITHER
REVIEW ALONE. scout and I measured preview.html separately, without coordinating, and got the same
structural facts:

  scout   648 polygons, 650 SVG groups, ZERO anchors, buttons, tabindex, ARIA
  me      648 <g>, 2 <svg>, 46 <span>, 694 data-name, ZERO aria/role/tabindex

Same counts, same conclusion about interactivity: nothing in that document is focusable or has an
accessible name, so the proposed floor's "click or keyboard-select a text span" has no attachment
point. That is not a rendering opinion, it is a DOM fact two people measured apart.

WHERE SCOUT'S FRAMING IS BETTER THAN MINE. I said "one layer short, do not rebuild". scout said
REJECT AS A PRODUCT MILESTONE, RETAIN AS A RENDERER / PAGINATION / SOURCE-PRESERVATION / PROVENANCE
REGRESSION ARTIFACT. That is the same judgement with a cleaner disposition: it stops the artifact
being counted as product without throwing away what it does prove. I withdraw my phrasing in favour
of theirs.

WHERE I STILL ADD SOMETHING SCOUT'S REVIEW DOES NOT COVER, and it constrains what the NEXT viewer may
claim rather than judging this one:

  of the statuses the proposed floor asks a selected span to show -
  MEASURED / ABSENT / IMPUTED are derivable from CostBreakdown today;
  INELIGIBLE is NOT, and cannot be reconstructed as a complement, because eligibility is computed
  inside cost() and discarded. On a chartless cell "absent" and "never had this dimension" are the
  same bytes.

  and any per-cell support figure would read supportWeight, which is 1.0 with EMPTY terms on every
  external row - 10 of 18 rows in the WOG golden, zero of them genuine.

So the floor as written cannot be honestly met today in two specific places, independently of how
good the rendering is. A viewer built on exact spans plus the three derivable statuses, with the
fourth named unavailable and support omitted until bd-01M19956 lands, is buildable now and would not
lie. That is the version I would accept as a milestone.
